title: Expose Engine::register_singleton in internal C++ API
key_points: The pull request proposes to expose `Engine::register_singleton` in the internal C++ API.
It suggests using a similar function call for both GDExtension and module code.
Renaming functions and keeping compatibility with GDExtensions are discussed.
limitations: The relevance of this change is determined by its inclusion into Godot's source codebase, which may take time.
asserts: The source claims that exposing `Engine::register_singleton` in the internal C++ API will improve compatibility between GDExtensions and module code.
